subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 3: Vocabulary and Grammar (The face)
outcomes: I can name face parts and hair colours.
I can describe people with He's got and She's got.
I can read and write ar words like star and shark.

tf.s: We say She's got for a girl.
tf.why: Great! She is for a girl.

tf.s: We say She's got for a boy.
tf.why: We say He's got for a boy.

tf.s: In the song, Claire has got red hair.
tf.why: Well done! She's got red hair.

tf.s: In the song, Piers has got blue eyes.
tf.why: Yes! Piers has got blue eyes.

tf.s: Fair, brown, red and black can be hair colours.
Our mouth is on top of our head.
tf.why: Our mouth is on our face, under the nose.

boxes.why: She's got is for a girl.
He's got is for a boy.
In the song, her name's Claire.
We say What do you see?
Our ears are on our head, by our face.

hunt.q: It's in the middle of your face.
It shines in the sky at night.
We wear it in cold weather.

mcq.q: Which word is a face word?
mcq.why: The mouth is on our face.

mcq.q: Which is a hair colour in this lesson?
mcq.why: Fair hair is light yellow hair.

mcq.q: Which letters make the sound in "park"?
Who has got blue eyes in the song?
Your friend Sara has got brown eyes. What do you say?
mcq.why: Sara is a girl: She's got brown eyes.

mcq.q: Complete: His name's ___. He's got blue eyes.
mcq.why: His is for a boy: Piers.

mcq.q: Write the word for a picture of a star.
Which sentence is right for a boy?
mcq.why: For a boy we say He's got.

mcq.q: Which is the odd one out?
mcq.why: Toes are on our feet; the others are on our face.

mcq.q: Which word does NOT have ar?
